title: Port Daddy proof-estate corpus
description: Rescoped in wave-p1/proof-estate from origin/codex/whitepaper-corpus-defrag's broader (and relocation-requiring) whitepaper corpus schema -- see corpus.json's scopeNote for why. This version covers only the formal-artifact and research-program manifest: every machine-checkable proof/model file and every executed-result script must be either WIRED (a CI job runs it) or explicitly RETIRED (with a reason). No third state.

enabled.description: Opt-in switch. When true, the checker fails if any path in `roots` exists. Left false on wave-p1/proof-estate because those roots are this branch's real, current, unmoved file layout -- see `reason`.

job.description: The CI job name(s) (job id, as it appears in the owning workflow file) that run this artifact.

authority.description: design-claim: backs a whitepaper/ADR-level claim, not necessarily 1:1 with shipped code (analyses/, docs/adr/models/). product-runtime: models an actually-shipped code path (proofs/**, core/harbor-card-rs).

paths.description: Repo-relative paths this artifact covers. A TLA+ model and its .cfg siblings are one entry; a Kani entry names the single .rs file its harness lives in (see harnessName).

harnessName.description: Required (by convention, not enforced in JSON Schema) when method is Kani: the #[kani::proof] function name this entry covers. One entry per harness, even when several share a path.

evidencePolicy.description: What backs the `current`/`partial` claim: a committed transcript, a CI artifact, or (for `retired`/`partial` entries) what's missing.
